# Immutable CrealityPrint recovery reference

These files are retained byte-for-byte from CrealityPrint v7.1.0, commit
`7622ae4518f7988965a6bd32ca41ea1c59e4dec0`. They are not built from this directory.
`provenance.json` records SHA-256 values and the source repository.
`LICENSE.txt` retains the upstream GNU Affero General Public License v3 text.

Git line-ending conversion is disabled here to preserve the hashes. Original
upstream whitespace is retained. See [the fork source notes](../../docs/adaptive-temperature-sources.md).
Run `python scripts/check_creality_recovery.py` from the repository root for
an offline reference/code check.
